material.text: Price sits on the 50-day average, the average price paid since the Aug 5 high and the 38.2% retracement of the Oct 8–Oct 22 rise, where 5 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +33% in 10 sessions, then drifted for 4 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 49% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

material.head: Next support −4.5% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −4.5% below (0.9 ATR), where 10 levels (4 kinds) meet: the April breakout level, the average price paid since the Oct 8 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 8–Oct 22 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Holding its rising 50-day
material.text: It dipped to its rising 50-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.
